note: Per body: object (JPL's orbit), q (mode Q: fields and its picked missions), map (mode M, every keep-th launch date and time of flight: dep (MJD), tof (days), and for each field a [tof][dep] array; null where JPL has no trip) and min (the cheapest point of the full map for vinf_dep, vinf_arr and their sum).

q.warning: pre-computed missions are based on an outdated orbit solution

horizons.note: Heliocentric, ICRF, J2000 ecliptic; km and km/s; keyed by MJD (TDB). From JPL Horizons (https://ssd.jpl.nasa.gov/horizons/).
